_readme: One row per legacy Squarespace article/blog URL. status: 'index' (listing page to /field-notes), 'mapped' (target is an existing Field Notes article), 'planned' (target article not written yet; review build keeps a temporary redirect), 'decision' (no article equivalent; James decides). Production builds fail unless every row resolves to a published article, /field-notes, or a decision with approvedBy. vercel.json redirects are checked against this file by tests/field-notes.test.mjs. audit: 'content-verified' (target compared with the original article's content), 'title-only' (matched by title only; needs a content comparison before the redirect can be made permanent). Production requires content-verified for every mapped row.
